description: M.P. Sumanawathi v. M.B. Jayakaduwa M.P. Sumanawathi v. M.B. Jayakaduwa View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: M.P. Sumanawathi v. M.B. Jayakaduwa M.P. Sumanawathi v. M.B. Jayakaduwa View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s dismissal of her action for declaration of title, ejectment and damages. Held - Although Appellant relied on documentary title, she had failed to establish possession or properly identify the boundaries of the land. Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
